tasks.label: compile and run active C/C++ file
tasks.command: if [ "${fileExtname}" = ".c" ]; then gcc -g "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}" && "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; elif [ "${fileExtname}" = ".cpp" ] || [ "${fileExtname}" = ".cc" ] || [ "${fileExtname}" = ".cxx" ]; then g++ -g "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}" && "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; else echo "Not a C/C++ file"; fi
